title: Apify Python SDK - concept article scraper input

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Docs pages to scrape. Typically the concept links collected by the sdk-concept-links Actor.

maxArticles.title: Maximum articles
maxArticles.description: Caps how many of the given URLs are scraped. Leave empty to scrape all of them.

maxTextLength.title: Maximum text length
maxTextLength.description: Characters of article prose kept per page.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages are fetched in parallel.
